summary: Curbline Properties Corp. filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for a forward-sale offering of 10,000,000 common shares (up to 11,500,000 with overallotment). Shares are borrowed and sold by forward purchasers (Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Wells Fargo); Curbline receives proceeds only upon physical settlement within ~18 months, with option for cash or net-share settlement. The last sale price was $31.27/share. The structure defers proceeds and dilutes over time; proceeds are for general corporate purposes, not a return of capital directly. Watch forward settlement elections and any cash-settlement risk, which could reduce or eliminate proceeds. Risk-arb angle: minimal typical arbitrage, but monitor execution timing and settlement method.
